chars.DAD: DAD: a Moroccan man in his fifties wearing a dusty orange construction work jacket with grey reflective stripes, beige work trousers and brown work boots, a small bandage on the side of his bald white head.
chars.MOM: MOM: a Moroccan woman in her forties wearing a deep burgundy djellaba with gold trim and a cream headscarf.
chars.SON: SON: a teenage boy wearing a bright yellow hoodie, black jeans and white sneakers.
chars.SIS: SIS: a young girl wearing a pink school tracksuit with a white stripe and a ponytail scrunchie on her bald head.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In the doorway of a modest Marrakech house with a blue wooden door, the father in work clothes is leaving, staring blankly and coldly at his family; the mother grabs his arm pleading, the son and the little girl look at him desperately. Strong tension, the father does not recognize them.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: A narrow terracotta Marrakech derb in the morning: the father walks away alone in his work clothes, seen from behind, while the mother, son and girl watch worried from the blue door.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Evening inside a simple Moroccan living room with sedari couches: the mother stands at the window looking out anxiously, the little girl hugs her leg, a wall clock shows late.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: The son sits next to his mother on the sedari couch, reassuring her with a calm hand gesture while she looks unconvinced and worried, mint tea on a round table.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Night, a Moroccan dinner table with a tajine and an empty chair at the head of the table; the mother, son and girl stare sadly at the empty chair.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Inside a Moroccan police station: the mother shows a printed photo to a Moroccan police officer in a dark blue uniform at a desk, the son and girl stand anxious beside her.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: A busy Moroccan street with shops: the mother, son and girl run happily with relieved faces toward the father who stands far away on the other side of the street.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot on the same street: the father faces his family with an empty cold stare and crossed arms, as if they are strangers; the mother and son are frozen in shock, the girl reaches out to him.
